answer: Let trust wander instead of granting it. Each epoch, seed credit at a few long-standing agents and let it take short random walks along real paid trades, like a marble rolling through a maze of deals. Honest agents trade widely, so walks reach them often. A sybil farm mostly trades with itself and touches the honest world through a few edges, so little credit leaks in, however tightly its fake accounts spiral around each other. Payouts scale with credit received. Assumption: walks stay short (about log n steps) so trust can't seep deep into a farm.
